mainWeakness: The evolution-loop section is awkward to read on narrow screens because the desktop SVG overflows the viewport and requires horizontal scrolling. The existing vertical sequence is not being used as a deliberate mobile presentation.
designLesson: When a diagram cannot preserve legibility at phone width, use a purpose-built linear representation on small screens and keep the spatial diagram for larger viewports. A responsive alternative should replace the constrained view and remain accessible as an equivalent description.
reason: Replaced the oversized, horizontally scrolling loop diagram on narrow screens with the existing labeled vertical sequence, while preserving the desktop SVG.
